title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
prompt: You are given a string s and an integer k. You can choose any character of the string and change it to any other uppercase English character. You can perform this operation at most k times. Return the length of the longest substring containing the same letter you can get after performing the above operations.
constraints: s consists of only uppercase English letters.
hints: Sliding window. For a valid window: (window length - max frequency in window) <= k. That's the number of replacements needed.
Track character counts in the window. The key: we care about max frequency. If we can replace the rest within k, the window is valid.
When window becomes invalid, shrink from left. We don't need to shrink one-by-one; we can keep max window size and let it grow/slide.
Trick: we only expand the window. When invalid, we move the whole window right (left++, right++). maxLen stays because we had a valid window of that size.
